Hi Ayla —

Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer (inference) role — I’m Hannah, the recruiter on the role. Would love to get a quick 20-minute intro call so the hiring team can learn more about your background and to run through the role.

Can you share 3 x 20-minute windows you have this week (PST preferred) and your timezone? If it helps, here are a few options I have open:
• Tue 2028-08-01: 9:00–11:00 PT
• Wed 2028-08-02: 13:00–15:00 PT
• Thu 2028-08-03: 17:00–18:00 PT

If none of those work, tell me the days/times that do and I’ll try to coordinate. Also include the best phone number to reach you and whether you prefer Google Meet or phone.

I’ll loop in the hiring manager after we lock a time.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
